discovery.note: Reusable saved Derby city catalog. Ranking uses the existing opportunity score (catalog demand, competition, affluence and priority points). Catalog searchDemand is derived from the saved priority list, not live search-demand measurement. Placeholder catalog distanceKm values were not used.

selectionRule: Take the ten areas returned by discoverPharmacyAreas({ town: "Derby", limit: 10 }). Mark all ten selected for this demonstration. The engine default would select only the first eight; Spondon and Borrowash are included to meet the ten-area request, not because live demand data ranked them highest.
